notes.title: ⚔️ Saber Survivors – Major Update is Live for Summer Sale 2025! 🛡️🔥
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="oWbXu_jPHBc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey Deflectors![/p][p]We’ve been cooking up something big — and it’s finally here. Just in time for the [b]Steam Summer Sale 2025[/b], our [b]Major Update[/b] for [i]Saber Survivors[/i] is live and packed with brand-new content, features, and improvements based on your amazing feedback. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Meet the New Warriors![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/c7defc33067ac75ddfe9d2f5087c3d5790b9aa16.gif"][/img][/p][p]Tired of the same ol’ crew? Say hello to [b]New Warriors[/b], each bringing their own playstyle, flair, and strategic edge. Whether you’re a Tanker or a Saber master — we’ve got someone for you.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Meta Progression Has Arrived![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/d72fa0a809dcb021c9bc32d2d4a08d51633aa144.png"][/img][/p][p]You asked, we listened.
We’ve added a full-fledged [b]Meta Progression system[/b] — unlock powerful upgrades that carry across runs, so you feel stronger, faster, and smarter every time you deflect into battle.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Skills, New Combos, New Mayhem[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/00ede609ef6590a2968dcba4eb0574882806a93b.gif"][/img][/p][p]More toys for your deflection arsenal!
We’ve added a wave of [b]new skills[/b] to discover and combine. Experiment with builds, unleash synergy-driven chaos, and craft your ultimate survivor loadout.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Biome Unlocked: Welcome to the Dreadstar[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/f274d7ab7fc81dc4d1fa8df13026cca7d363c938.gif"][/img][/p][p]Burnt out in the desert? [/p][p]Journey into [b]Dreadstar[/b] — a mysterious, hostile biome filled with troopers threats, eerie atmosphere, and unique challenges. It’s darker. It’s deadlier. It’s deflect-or-die.[/p][p][/p][p][b]💬 We’d Love Your Feedback![/b] [/p][p]Try out the new update and let us know what you think! Have ideas for new features or balance changes? Drop your feedback in the comments below.  [/p][p]Happy deflecting! 🗡️✨[/p]

notes.title: MAY THE SPACE CHI BE WITH YOU - Saber Survivors is now available!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=NoTPp_i7OIE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]IT’S HERE![/b]

After months of hard work, ups and downs, we proudly announce that our next game is finally ready!

This is our homage to our childhood. When we were kids, we were always hooked on Sci-Fi movies. We dreamed of being warriors in space, far, far away… and hoped that someday we could go on space travels and wield that signature laser sword.

Well, now you can! As a [b]Space Wizard Samurai[/b], wield your saber, deflect projectiles from the bad guys, outsmart enemies, and explore a space planet filled with raiders and giant worms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/f5daca119b9b107baa6b20289de6e7be1cfa95d5.gif[/img]

[b]Saber Survivors[/b] puts you in the shoes of a Space Wizard Samurai. While on a mission to a desert planet, the Evil Galactic Emperor declares that all Space Wizard Samurais must be exterminated. Now, you must fight to survive, armed with only a saber to deflect laser beams.

We love making bite-sized games packed with intense action, and this one is no exception. Saber Survivors will test your reflexes, precision, and wit as you navigate through barrages of laser fire. Do you stay and deflect the bullets, or do you move to dodge them? Survive, and [b]May the Space Chi be with You![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/bcad1c9c46c19902baea516163a2b7bd2cf71064.gif[/img]

Lastly, we also want to thank our publisher, Toge Productions, for their trust and support from the beginning of this project. Thank you to the amazing localization team, our family and friends, the community, and especially [i][b]you[/b][/i]—our players, with whom we want to share this experience. Thank you so, so much!

We had an amazing time creating [b]Saber Survivors[/b], and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it.

Sending love to all of you from all of us at Reima Project!

Warm regards,
Reima Project
